text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"For the peace of this world—I will strike 
you down!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A wizard unleashing lightning. Yet, the 
dragon's breath comes crashing down—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...*yaaaawn*. Huh? Is it really that late 
already...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm, but just a little bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft ended up staying up late, 
totally absorbed in a fantasy novel.
